<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1/crypto/wallet/{walletId}/json-signature/sign"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Signs a JSON payload, bound to a context (purpose, target, validity window...), using the SDK JSON signatures. Supports `json-canonical+utf8` and `jws` (the latter requires a wallet backed by a JWK private key).
